prompt: Create exactly one 9:16 vertical style reference sheet — a texture and palette sample, not a scene. Medium: clay/stop-motion-like. Texture family: soft doughy sculpted surface with rounded hand-formed volumes, subtle fingerprints, gentle compression marks and matte tactile clay grain. Palette: earthy sky blues, muted greens, warm stone grays, soft clay browns and cream highlights, with restrained metallic accents for machines and structures. Line treatment: Minimal sculpted contours and soft edge definition created through form separation, shallow grooves and molded surface transitions rather than drawn outlines. Lighting: Soft studio-like natural daylight with broad shadows, gentle ambient bounce and clear weight-related form changes. Avoid: No enclosing pages or entry-object masks; no embedded text or unsupported factual imagery. No characters, no text, no logos, no photorealism. [VISUAL_CONTRACT:material_anchor_v2] Fill the canvas with a neutral material/palette sample, not a framed page, book, landscape, gateway, inset illustration or host.
